visualCharacteristics.purpose: row of image cards each linking to an article or adventure detail page
visualCharacteristics.description:
Recent Articles: Underlined h2 title (short yellow underline), 4 image cards in a row, yellow 'All Articles' button, closed by an hr separator (section break).
Where do you want to go: h3 title (no underline), 4 adventure cards in a row identical in style to Recent Articles, yellow 'All Trips' button, closed by hr separator.

contentPattern.structure: one row per card; cell 1 = card image (with alt), cell 2 = title as linked heading/strong and description paragraph

cells.name: text
cells.content: title as linked heading/strong, description paragraph

usage: Home page (https://wknd.site/us/en.html), used twice: 'Recent Articles' (4 magazine article cards) and 'Where do you want to go' (4 adventure cards). Section heading and the 'All Articles' / 'All Trips' button are default content around the block.
reuseGuidance: Use for a grid of 4 image cards, each with a linked title and short description, pointing to detail pages. 4 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile.
